title: Shark and Red Tide relationship
text: Welcome! This website explores the relationship between coastal shark communities in South Florida and Karenia brevis harmful algal blooms (red tide), combining three public datasets:

title: Shark and Red Tide relationship
text:
Interactive Shark Migration Map
Hover over any capture or recapture point to inspect the individual shark’s tag, date, days at liberty, and ocean distance traveled, or click a species in the legend to highlight its tracks.






Visit the Data page to see how all three datasets are loaded into R.
